neighbours.label: the rival party that is pulling ahead in a falling-behind comparison ('behind those of other nations', 'keep pace with the modern powers', 'losing customers to newer stores')
fire: Our hospitals have fallen well behind those of other regions.
The railway could not keep up with the faster modern airlines.
Small farms are losing ground to larger industrial rivals.
The country's universities trail far behind those of other economies.
The old workshop was left behind as new factories took over the trade.
Our team keeps slipping further behind other clubs in the league.
The kingdom stagnated while neighboring states raced ahead.
Traditional newspapers are being overtaken by newer digital outlets.
quiet: Our hospitals are funded by taxes from other regions.
The railway runs alongside the modern highway.
Small farms sell vegetables to larger industrial buyers.
The country's universities welcome students from other economies.
The old workshop was painted and new windows were installed.
Our team plays against other clubs in the league.
The kingdom traded peacefully with neighboring states.
Traditional newspapers are sold beside newer digital magazines.

notes: Card: no single token: ' other' in 'as other countries surge ahead' / 'falling behind those of other countries', ' new' in 'as new knowledge superceded old', ' dynamic' United States beside the stagnated; also 'would have liked' and 'aid allocation', which this label does not cover. Probes: 'lagging/falling behind those of other nations/countries' 0.61-0.70, 'keep pace with the modern industrial powers' 0.43, 'losing customers to newer online stores' 0.38, 'as new techniques replaced them' 0.32; 'other'/'new' without the comparison 0.02-0.11; 'would have liked' 0.05.
